statement: The function returns a result r (a 64-bit integer) and r = |{ (i,j) | 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n and R(i)+C(j) is odd }|, where R(i) = |{ k | 0 <= k < len(indices) and indices[k][0] = i }| for 0 <= i < m, and C(j) = |{ k | 0 <= k < len(indices) and indices[k][1] = j }| for 0 <= j < n.
